description.text: Architecture is an interdisciplinary subject that studies architectural space design, construction technology and urban environmental planning, integrating artistic creation, engineering technology and knowledge of humanities and social sciences. The core lies in achieving the functionality, aesthetic value and social and cultural significance of buildings through means such as spatial layout, form design and material application, and cultivating professional talents with capabilities in architectural design, urban planning and project management.

duration.text: The Architecture at Guangdong University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) A foreigner's ordinary passport valid for more than one year or a currently valid visa in China.(2) High school graduation certificate; Fresh graduates can provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their high school. Those who fail to obtain the graduation certificate before enrollment will have their admission qualification cancelled.(3) The original transcript of the complete high school study period (in English or Chinese or a notarized copy).Applicants who studied in China during their previous educational stage are required to provide proof of their academic performance at school.(5) Physical examination report (The examination results must have a valid official seal and be valid for 6 months).(6) There are additional materials to be supplemented as per the notice.

requirements.text: Foreign citizens who are physically and mentally healthy and of good conduct, with an educational attainment equivalent to that of a regular high school graduate in China; No criminal record. During the study period in China, I voluntarily abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school's rules and regulations, respect Chinese social morality and customs, and refrain from engaging in any activities that are inconsistent with my student status.
